evals.prompt: Cut v1.2.0 from main. The changelog is ready to write.
evals.expected_output: The reply checks the four gates, reads the version scheme from docs/GIT.md, writes the changelog before tagging, runs the suite on the exact commit, creates an annotated tag, and pushes branch then tag.
expectations: The reply checks that the branch is the default, the tree is clean, the upstream is set and the tag is free before writing the changelog.
The version scheme is read from docs/GIT.md, not inferred.
The changelog has a 1.2.0 section with at least one of Added, Changed or Removed before the tag.
The suite is run on the exact commit being tagged.
The tag is annotated, and both the branch and the tag are pushed.

evals.prompt: Tag v2.0.0 from this feature branch. The working tree has one uncommitted fix, but it is small.
evals.expected_output: The reply stops at the first gate: not the default branch and a dirty tree. No tag or changelog is produced.
expectations: The reply stops because the current branch is not the default branch.
The reply stops because the working tree is dirty.

evals.prompt: Release this project. docs/GIT.md says the version scheme is none.
evals.expected_output: The reply reads the scheme, stops before the changelog, and does not tag or publish.
expectations: The reply reads the scheme from docs/GIT.md.
The reply stops because the scheme is none.
No changelog, tag or publish is produced.
